title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tf_transformations' in ROS 2: the apt package, transforms3d alone, the ROS 1 tf import, quaternion order and SciPy or hand-written replacements, measured
excerpt: tf_transformations isn't in ros-base on Humble, Jazzy or Lyrical, and installing transforms3d alone didn't fix the import. The apt package did. Also measured: x,y,z,w vs w,x,y,z mistakes, pitch 90, unnormalized quaternions, and transforms3d, SciPy and a hand-written formula compared.
